newsitem.title: USA: Effective Mgmt posts expected Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: Effective Mgmt posts expected Q1 loss.

text.p: Effective Management Systems Inc Tuesday reported an expected loss of $883,000, or $0.22 a share, in the first quarter ended February 28, versus a loss one year ago of $91,000, or $0.02 a share.

The company, which provides software for manufacturing operations, said the loss primarily reflected an unanticipated delay in the finalization of a major contract with an unidentified company. Effective Management said it also experienced some softness in new-account sales in the period.
Revenues dipped slightly to $9.5 million from $9.6 million, the company said.
Effective Management Systems shares closed unchanged Tuesday at 6-1/4.
